title: Oracle CX Review (2026)
intro: Oracle Fusion Cloud CX / Sales CRM for enterprise pipeline, forecasting, and Oracle stack integration. This review covers verified 2026 pricing, core CRM capabilities, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: Oracle CX scores reflect first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: Oracle CX Sales fits enterprises standardized on Oracle that need Fusion-grade SFA, forecasting, and stack integration. Expect custom quotes and high admin overhead. Approximate $65 Professional list is directional only. Not hands-on tested.
